d:
Every haunted location comes with its own disturbing history and stories that leave witnesses searching for answers. From the eerie streets of Locke and the infamous Winchester Mystery House to an abandoned prison and a reportedly haunted restaurant, Zak Bagans and his crew investigate unexplained experiences and accounts that refuse to be forgotten. But will their investigations reveal what lies behind these unsettling stories?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 12, Episodes 7, 10, 5, 8, 1 and 11, on Discovery Channel India.
